mapper.select: SELECT r.*, u.nickname as userName, o.order_no as orderNo FROM review r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.id ORDER BY r.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (order_id, user_id, score, content) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{score}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE review SET reply = #{reply} WHERE id = #{id}
